summary_pt: Números, licença e representação são consistentes com o README; a cadeia de produção dos arrays não está publicada. Não integrar nem medir blends até comprovar identidade dos dados, atribuição de folds e vínculo do exportador com estes bytes. Isso não constitui acusação de vazamento.
scope: Own audit only; no fit, blend, submission, external model import or external script execution. NPY files loaded with allow_pickle=False.
positive_evidence: Official Kaggle CLI authenticated download pinned to dataset version 2; CC0-1.0 metadata and README agree.
All three arrays have expected row counts, finite float64 values and scores outside [0,1], compatible with the declared log-odds representation.
Conditional pooled AUC and all five fold AUCs reproduce the README rounding exactly under the declared train row order and 5/42 split.
Conditional rank correlations reproduce the README rounding: OOF versus Masaya 0.9894867, test5 versus test0 0.9977258, test5 versus Masaya 0.9932500.
The current same-author consumer notebook pins the test5 SHA256 and the distributed version2 file matches that pin.

The referenced MIT source has an explicit fit/held-out split, uses only fit rows for fold fine-tuning and prior, verifies OOF row membership, and aggregates test log-odds across fold models. Those code properties do not bind this release to a producing run.
blocking_gaps: No producer-side raw train/test CSV hashes, ordered IDs or row fingerprints are distributed. Our exact CSV hashes match the expected local competition files, but there is no source value to compare.

No seed2026 fold_ids.npy, validation-index files or per-fold score artifacts are distributed. Its 5/42 equivalence to Masaya is asserted in README only. The local Masaya fold assignment does match local canonical 5/42, which cannot prove seed2026 producing folds.

No release manifest binds the array SHA256s to a source commit, training/scoring commands, input fingerprints, fold/checkpoint hashes, or execution logs. README names the public code without an immutable producing revision.

The referenced exporter is available in the base repository, but its seed2026 run manifest/score chunks and output rename linkage are absent. The same-author notebook consumes arrays and is not their exporter.

The claimed arithmetic average of five test fold-model log-odds cannot be reconstructed from the provided mean plus fold0 alone; fold1..fold4 individual predictions and checkpoint provenance are absent. No full-data refit is claimed in this release.
Outer-validation exclusion is correct in the referenced recipe, but exclusion by the models that produced these exact seed2026 arrays is not independently verified from distributed evidence.

representation.oof: README: per-row held-out log-odds, logsumexp over 10 orders per class, True minus False, plus training-fold prior log-odds. Observed logits, not probabilities.
representation.test5: README: arithmetic mean of the five fold models log-odds, 10 orders per fold. Use this file if the provenance gaps are resolved. This is not mean(sigmoid(logit)).
representation.test_f0: README: fold0 model log-odds only, retained for compatibility. Not equivalent to test5 and not the five-fold prediction.
representation.refit: No 100%-data refit or rank-mean combination is stated for these arrays.

numeric_evidence.limit: AUC/shape/correlation agreement supports numerical consistency with the author report, not row identity or training exclusion.

local_csv_identity_only.limit: These are hashes and IDs of our local CSVs only. The release does not publish corresponding values to compare.

folds.source_claim: StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42), identical to Masaya fold_ids.npy
folds.limit: Matching local canonical folds to Masaya confirms only our local reference, not the seed2026 producing assignment.

distributed_predictions.evidence: Official Kaggle metadata, version2 CLI download and README

referenced_recipe_code.requirement_for_source_reuse: Preserve copyright and MIT permission notice in copies or substantial portions.

base_pretrained_model.limit: License confirmed for the declared GPT-2 base; actual pretrained revision and replica/original-data fingerprints are not published for the seed2026 run.

credit: Masaya Kawamata / masayakawamata / Matapanino (public code and first seed)

consumer_notebook.limit: The inspected source consumes public arrays and freezes their hashes. It supplies no producing run or linkage to source CSVs, fold assignments or checkpoints.

minimum_to_reconsider: An immutable producer manifest with our exact train/test hashes or ordered IDs, producing code revision, commands/settings, base/replica/checkpoint identities and these output SHA256s.
Seed2026 producing fold assignment and exporter evidence demonstrating that each OOF index was excluded from its own model training.
A reconstructible test aggregation or bound run logs/artifacts identifying all five fold outputs, preserving log-odds semantics.

status.done: Private static/source and numerical consistency audit, with versioned bytes and hashes.
status.missing: Producer provenance listed above; therefore not validated or accepted for integration.
status.blocked: No access issue for the dataset. Public release lacks the producer evidence required by the established import contract.
